Create an access control entry

ace.Rd

Builds a single ACE for use with sd_add(). Types, flags, rights and well-known accounts can be given either as their SDDL abbreviation (e.g. "GA") or by description (e.g. "generic all"). See details for lookup tables.

Usage

ace(
  type = "allow",
  flags = NULL,
  rights = NULL,
  object_guid = NULL,
  inherit = NULL,
  account = NULL
)

Arguments

type

[character(1)]

ACE type. Defaults to "allow".

flags

[character]

ACE flags, e.g. c("CI", "OI").

rights

[character]

Access rights, e.g. c("GR", "GW").

object_guid, inherit

[character(1)]

Optional object GUIDs for object-specific ACE types.

account

[character(1)]

An alias, description or SID of a trusted account.

Value

A list of class "winpipe_ace".

Details

The following codes and descriptions can be used interchangeably for ACE components:

type:

CodeDescription
Aallow
Ddeny
OAobject-specific access allow
ODobject-specific access deny
AUsystem audit
ALsystem alarm
OUobject-specific system audit
MLmandatory label

flags:

CodeDescription
OIobject inherit
CIcontainer inherit
NPno propagate inherit
IOinherit only
IDinherited ACE
SAsuccessful access audit
FAfailed access audit

rights:

CodeDescription
GAgeneric all
GRgeneric read
GWgeneric write
GXgeneric execute
FAfile all access
FRfile generic read
FWfile generic write
FXfile generic execute
KAkey all access
KRkey read
KWkey write
KXkey execute
RPread property
WPwrite property
WDmodify permissions
RCread control
SDdelete
WOchange owner
NWno write up
NRno read up
NXno execute up

account:

CodeDescription
BAadmins
WDeveryone
SYlocal system
AUauthenticated users
LSlocal service
NSnetwork service
ANanonymous
IUinteractive users
COcreator owner
CGcreator group
ACall application packages
LWlow integrity
MEmedium integrity
HIhigh integrity
SIsystem integrity

Examples

# codes are allowed
ace("A", rights = "GA", account = "SY")
#> <winpipe_ace> (A;;GA;;;SY)

# as well as generic descriptions
ace("allow", rights = "generic all", account = "local system")
#> <winpipe_ace> (A;;GA;;;SY)
